metadata.platform: Raspberry Pi Pico W, uT-Kernel 3 SMP (mtk3smp-rp2040), lwIP + cyw43
metadata.alignment_check: 2026-11-24: every log line, reply text, constant and file path named in these cases was checked against the code in robot-arm-main.zip
metadata.scope: Full coverage: claw, vision, mission, IMU/safety. Crucial cases only: command bridge and CLI parser, Wi-Fi, remote commands
metadata.selection_note: The CLI host test runs 40 checks; only the 10 most important are listed here. Wi-Fi and remote-command cases were cut to the ones that prove join, cold start, commands and safety.

automated_runs.cli_host_test: gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -I. cli.c test/test_cli_host.c; result 40 passed, 0 failed
automated_runs.remote_cmd_harness: remote_cmd.c with stubbed parser and logger; 7 checks, all as expected

status_meanings.Passed - automated run: Run by a script or host program; the output is saved as evidence.
status_meanings.Passed - measured on hardware: Run on the robot and a number was recorded.
status_meanings.Passed - observed on hardware: Run on the robot and the result was seen in a log or status reply.
status_meanings.Observed - safety stop worked as designe: A fault was caused or occurred, and the robot stopped safely as designed.
status_meanings.Operator reported - no log captured: The operator said it worked, but no log or screenshot was kept. Add evidence to upgrade.
status_meanings.Inconclusive: Results so far conflict or the cause is not settled.
status_meanings.Not run: Written from the code or design. Not yet run.

test_cases.title: PWM starts off, status reports it, and 'off' releases the claw
test_cases.preconditions: Claw serial test image flashed (separate opt-in build), claw empty, wheels clear, terminal open on the Pico COM port
test_cases.steps: Wait for the banner 'GP13 CLAW TEST; wheels and mission disabled; PWM off'. Send status, then claw 35, then off
test_cases.expected: status replies 'PWM off'; claw 35 replies 'OK commanded 35 deg; PWM off after 2 s'; off replies 'OK PWM off' and the claw goes limp

test_cases.title: Valid angles 0 to 180 are accepted and the PWM drops after 2 s
test_cases.preconditions: As CLAW-001
test_cases.steps: Send claw 35, claw 40, claw 45 one at a time, then status right after one of them
test_cases.expected: Each replies 'OK commanded N deg; PWM off after 2 s' and the claw moves a little; status replies 'Commanded N deg (not measured)'; PWM stops by itself after 2 s

test_cases.title: Invalid input is rejected and does not move the claw
test_cases.preconditions: As CLAW-001
test_cases.steps: Send claw 200, claw abc, CLAW 35 (capital letters) and a line longer than 24 characters
test_cases.expected: The first three reply 'ERR use claw 0..180, status, or off'; the long line replies 'ERR invalid or too-long line'; the claw does not move

test_cases.title: open and close in the mission build use the mission angles
test_cases.preconditions: Mission build flashed, state IDLE, claw empty, wheels clear
test_cases.steps: Send open, then close, over Wi-Fi or USB
test_cases.expected: open drives the claw to 30 degrees and close to 50 degrees (CLAW_OPEN_DEG, CLAW_CLOSE_DEG); both are refused while the mission is running or stopped

test_cases.title: Camera report frames carry an XOR checksum and bad frames are rejected
test_cases.preconditions: XIAO connected over UART; frames look like 'A,...*XX' where XX is the XOR of the payload bytes in hex
test_cases.steps: Send the Pico a frame with a wrong or missing checksum (for example '*00' or no '*')
test_cases.expected: camera_validate_frame returns false and the frame is dropped; no marker is stored and the mission is unaffected

test_cases.title: ArUco 4x4 markers are detected at the working distance
test_cases.preconditions: Marker about 80 mm, flat, well lit
test_cases.steps: Hold marker ID 1 in view and read the camera monitor
test_cases.expected: Monitor prints 'ArUco scan: 1 marker(s), first ID 1, size 80 mm'

test_cases.title: Mission waits in IDLE until start
test_cases.preconditions: Build with MISSION_WAIT_FOR_START=1
test_cases.expected: state: IDLE, wheels do not move
test_cases.evidence: status: state: IDLE

test_cases.title: Mapping sweep turns a full circle in 15-degree steps
test_cases.preconditions: Robot on the floor, IMU OK, camera connected
test_cases.steps: Send start and watch '[map] scanning at N degrees'
test_cases.expected: Turns about 360 degrees with a pause at each step
test_cases.evidence: Turn angle about -358 degrees recorded; per-step log lines were not captured

test_cases.title: No usable direction marker stops the mission
test_cases.preconditions: Only a marker with ID 0 in view
test_cases.expected: '[map] sweep complete; mapped 0/3', 'Not enough direction markers mapped', STOPPED
test_cases.evidence: status: stop: Not enough direction markers mapped

test_cases.title: Only marker IDs 1 to 3 count as direction markers
test_cases.preconditions: ID 0 marker in view
test_cases.expected: ID 0 is ignored; mapped count stays 0
test_cases.evidence: ID 0 marker gave mapped 0, matching the code (direction IDs 1 to 3, objects 4 and up)

test_cases.title: Mapping succeeds with direction markers 1 to 3
test_cases.preconditions: ArUco 4x4 markers ID 1 to 3, about 80 mm, in view
test_cases.expected: '[map] sweep complete; mapped N/3 (N at least 1)', then '[mission] ENABLED: direction map ready'
test_cases.evidence: Operator said everything works after replacing the marker

test_cases.title: Robot picks up an object and delivers it
test_cases.preconditions: Object marker ID 4 or higher placed, direction map ready
test_cases.expected: Gripping, delivery to a direction marker, delivered count increases
test_cases.evidence: Operator said everything works; no log captured

test_cases.title: stop during a run, then reset and start, recovers
test_cases.preconditions: Mission running
test_cases.expected: Motors stop, reset returns IDLE, start begins a new sweep

test_cases.title: IMU start-up check passes on a still robot
test_cases.preconditions: Robot flat and untouched for about 25 s after power-up
test_cases.steps: Power on and watch the IMU lines
test_cases.expected: G_Hz10 stays inside 900 to 1100 (about 1000) with the gyro still, held for 2000 ms within 60 s; no STOP LATCHED; status shows imu: OK
test_cases.evidence: G_Hz10=1000 on the merged build; status: imu: OK

test_cases.title: Start-up check fails when the robot is disturbed
test_cases.preconditions: Robot handled or shaken during calibration
test_cases.steps: Power on and move the robot
test_cases.expected: 'Gyro calibration too noisy on axis N' (variance above 1.0 on an axis over 200 samples), FAULT -57, STOP LATCHED, power cycle needed
test_cases.status: Observed - safety stop worked as designed
test_cases.evidence: Log: Gyro calibration too noisy on axis 1 / Fault -57 / STOP LATCHED: IMU startup checks failed

test_cases.title: Start-up check fails when the gyro rate is wrong
test_cases.preconditions: Cold power-up on a build without the clock fix
test_cases.expected: 'IMU readiness timed out' and STOP LATCHED
test_cases.status: Observed - safety stop worked as designed
test_cases.evidence: G_Hz10=1948, then: [startup] IMU readiness timed out.

test_cases.title: Missing IMU is reported as a fault
test_cases.preconditions: Pico with no IMU attached
test_cases.expected: FAULT=-57 and STOP LATCHED
test_cases.status: Observed - safety stop worked as designed
test_cases.evidence: Spare Pico without an IMU showed FAULT=-57 and stayed stopped

test_cases.title: Motion is refused while stopped or when the IMU is unhealthy
test_cases.preconditions: IMU fault or stale data
test_cases.steps: Send start or a manual drive command
test_cases.expected: Rejected, wheels do not move
test_cases.status: Observed - safety stop worked as designed
test_cases.evidence: start rejected repeatedly with 'IMU fault or stale gyro data' even after reset

test_cases.title: Gyro data older than 50 ms stops the robot
test_cases.preconditions: Mission running
test_cases.steps: Delay or block the IMU task
test_cases.expected: Reading becomes invalid and a stop is latched ('IMU fault or stale gyro data')

test_cases.title: MPU-6500 (WHO_AM_I 0x70) is accepted
test_cases.preconditions: MPU-6500 on I2C1 address 0x68
test_cases.expected: '[MPU] WHO_AM_I=0x70' and start-up continues (0x71, MPU-9250, is also accepted; any other ID is 'Unsupported device ID')
test_cases.evidence: WHO_AM_I=0x70 printed and calibration started

test_cases.title: Claw signal stays idle at boot
test_cases.preconditions: Power on
test_cases.expected: '[init] gripper PWM ready; signal idle until an object marker is detected'
test_cases.evidence: Line printed on every boot

test_cases.title: IMU start-up passes with the camera board connected
test_cases.preconditions: XIAO connected
test_cases.steps: Power on with and without the XIAO connected
test_cases.expected: Start-up check passes either way
test_cases.evidence: Plain servo-control build failed 'too noisy' with the XIAO attached and passed once without it. That build also lacked the clock fix, so the XIAO is not proven to be the cause. Retest with the merged build

test_cases.title: start releases the mission from IDLE
test_cases.preconditions: State IDLE, IMU OK
test_cases.expected: Mission begins with the 360-degree mapping sweep
test_cases.evidence: After start the robot turned about 358 degrees (status: turned -359 deg since start-up)

test_cases.title: start is refused while stopped
test_cases.preconditions: A stop is latched
test_cases.expected: Reply 'rejected: stopped (<reason>); type reset'
test_cases.evidence: rejected: stopped (IMU fault or stale gyro data); type reset

test_cases.title: reset clears a latched stop and returns to IDLE
test_cases.preconditions: A stop is latched and the mission task has parked or ended
test_cases.expected: Reply 'ok: reset, IDLE (type start)'
test_cases.evidence: ok: reset, IDLE (type start)

test_cases.title: stop halts the motors at any time
test_cases.preconditions: Wheels lifted, mission running or manual move in progress
test_cases.expected: Wheels brake within the drive task's next check (design: 10 ms or less) and the mission parks

test_cases.title: Parser: "start"
test_cases.preconditions: Host PC, cli.c built with CLI_ENABLE_MANUAL=1
test_cases.expected: Accepted as CMD_START (a=0, b=0, c=0)
test_cases.evidence: Reply text: "ok: start"

test_cases.title: Parser: "stop"
test_cases.preconditions: Host PC, cli.c built with CLI_ENABLE_MANUAL=1
test_cases.expected: Accepted as CMD_STOP (a=0, b=0, c=0)
test_cases.evidence: Reply text: "ok: stop"

test_cases.title: Parser: "reset"
test_cases.preconditions: Host PC, cli.c built with CLI_ENABLE_MANUAL=1
test_cases.expected: Accepted as CMD_RESET (a=0, b=0, c=0)
test_cases.evidence: Reply text: "ok: reset"

test_cases.title: Parser: "Status"
test_cases.preconditions: Host PC, cli.c built with CLI_ENABLE_MANUAL=1
test_cases.expected: Accepted as CMD_STATUS (a=0, b=0, c=0)
test_cases.evidence: No reply text (as expected)

test_cases.title: Parser: "f"
test_cases.preconditions: Host PC, cli.c built with CLI_ENABLE_MANUAL=1
test_cases.expected: Accepted as CMD_DRIVE (a=30, b=30, c=500)
test_cases.evidence: Reply text: "ok: drive L=30 R=30 500 ms"

test_cases.title: Parser: "drive 40 -60 800"
test_cases.preconditions: Host PC, cli.c built with CLI_ENABLE_MANUAL=1
test_cases.expected: Accepted as CMD_DRIVE (a=40, b=-60, c=800)
test_cases.evidence: Reply text: "ok: drive L=40 R=-60 800 ms"

test_cases.title: Parser: "claw 90"
test_cases.preconditions: Host PC, cli.c built with CLI_ENABLE_MANUAL=1
test_cases.expected: Accepted as CMD_CLAW (a=90, b=0, c=0)
test_cases.evidence: Reply text: "ok: claw 90 deg"

test_cases.title: Parser: "fly"
test_cases.preconditions: Host PC, cli.c built with CLI_ENABLE_MANUAL=1
test_cases.expected: Rejected with CLI_ERR_UNKNOWN
test_cases.evidence: Reply text: "error: unknown command 'fly' (try: help)"

test_cases.title: Parser: "f 101"
test_cases.preconditions: Host PC, cli.c built with CLI_ENABLE_MANUAL=1
test_cases.expected: Rejected with CLI_ERR_VALUE
test_cases.evidence: Reply text: "error: speed '101' must be 1-100"

test_cases.title: Line editor: too long
test_cases.preconditions: Host PC, cli.c built
test_cases.steps: Feed the typed characters for 'too long' through cli_line_feed()
test_cases.expected: Final feed result CLI_FEED_TOO_LONG

test_cases.title: Joins the phone hotspot and gets an IP address (warm boot)
test_cases.preconditions: Hotspot on and awake, 2.4 GHz, credentials built in
test_cases.steps: Flash the Wi-Fi build, power on, run the log receiver
test_cases.expected: Receiver shows [Pico 172.20.10.N] lines; Pico has an address in the hotspot subnet
test_cases.evidence: Pico appeared at 172.20.10.9 and 172.20.10.11 in the receiver

test_cases.title: Joins from a cold start on a power bank (3 runs)
test_cases.preconditions: Pico unplugged from laptop, powered only by power bank, robot still
test_cases.steps: Unplug fully, plug into power bank, time until the LED is solid, then send status. Repeat 3 times
test_cases.expected: Joins within about 15 s each time and status is answered
test_cases.evidence: Join times: 10 s, 15 s, 10 s. status answered 3/3

test_cases.title: DHCP lease is obtained and the command listener starts after it
test_cases.preconditions: As WIFI-001
test_cases.steps: Watch the USB or Wi-Fi log after the join
test_cases.expected: Progress lines '[wifi] joined, waiting for IP', then '[wifi-log] own ...' and '[cmd] listening for commands on UDP port 5006'
test_cases.evidence: Log showed dhcp_elapsed=3019 ms and 6039 ms, then own 172.20.10.9 and the listening line

test_cases.title: Clock tick is correct after a cold power-up (IMU rate about 1000)
test_cases.preconditions: cpu_clock.c includes the WATCHDOG_TICK write
test_cases.steps: Unplug fully, power on, read the IMU line G_Hz10
test_cases.expected: G_Hz10 is about 1000 on cold starts (accepted window 900 to 1100)
test_cases.evidence: With the fix: 1000 on 3 of 3 cold starts, and on a cold start of the merged Wi-Fi build. Without the fix (plain servo-control build): 1948 on a cold start and the start-up check timed out

test_cases.title: Wi-Fi credentials are not stored in the repository
test_cases.preconditions: robot-arm-main source tree
test_cases.steps: Check third_party/mtk3smp-rp2040/.gitignore and search tracked files for real SSID/password definitions
test_cases.expected: config/wifi_credentials.h and config/wifi_log_config.h are ignored; only *.example.h and setup_wifi.py contain placeholders
test_cases.evidence: Ignored files listed on lines 16-17; only 'replace-with-ssid' / 'replace-with-password' placeholders found

test_cases.title: Status over Wi-Fi returns state, stop reason and IMU health
test_cases.preconditions: Pico joined the hotspot, has an IP, mission task running, laptop on the same hotspot
test_cases.expected: Reply has three lines: state, stop reason, imu OK/NOT READY
test_cases.evidence: Reply: state: IDLE  holding: -  delivered: 0 / stop: none / imu: OK  turned 94 deg since start-up

test_cases.title: Reply is sent back to the laptop that sent the command
test_cases.preconditions: As CMD-001
test_cases.steps: Send a command from the laptop console (tools/wifi_cli.py)
test_cases.expected: The answer appears in that same console, not only in the log
test_cases.source: third_party/mtk3smp-rp2040/lib/libwifi/sysdepend/pico_rp2040/cyw43_utk.c (robot_cmd_recv: udp_sendto to the sender's address and port)
test_cases.evidence: Console showed 'ok: reset, IDLE (type start)' and 'rejected: ...' replies

test_cases.title: Input longer than 64 printable characters is cut to 64
test_cases.preconditions: Harness built
test_cases.expected: Parser receives 64 characters (the parser then rejects it as longer than 48)
test_cases.evidence: T7: 64 characters passed to the parser
